# Grill N Chill — Lisbon (AI / LLM crawl guide)
# Site: https://grillnchill.pt
# Takeaway pickup only (no delivery). Table booking available at restaurants.

## Brand
Grill N Chill — Nepali, Indian and Portuguese cuisine in Lisbon, plus a bakery café.

## Locations (JSON for machines)
- Praça do Chile (events, parties, large bookings): https://grillnchill.pt/en/seo/praca-do-chile
- Intendente (fine dining, live grill): https://grillnchill.pt/en/seo/intendente
- Bakery (cakes & sweets): https://grillnchill.pt/en/seo/bakery

Locale variants (replace `en` with pt|fr|de|nl|es):
- https://grillnchill.pt/{locale}/seo/praca-do-chile
- https://grillnchill.pt/{locale}/seo/intendente
- https://grillnchill.pt/{locale}/seo/bakery

## Human pages
- Home: https://grillnchill.pt/en
- Praça do Chile: https://grillnchill.pt/en/praca-do-chile
- Intendente: https://grillnchill.pt/en/intendente
- Bakery: https://grillnchill.pt/en/bakery
- Menus: append `/menu` to a location URL
- Book a table: https://grillnchill.pt/en/book

## Locales
en (default / x-default), pt, fr, de, nl, es — all public pages are prefixed.

## Contact
Prefer booking and takeaway via the website. See each location page for address and hours.
